notes: Full document chain present: purchase order (2026-08-01) -> invoice (2026-08-09, references PO-1014) -> goods receipt (2026-08-11, references both INV-1014 and PO-1014) -> bank payment and ledger entry (both 2026-08-14, referencing INV-1014/PO-1014/SPS-2208). Amounts are consistent at 246000 INR across PO, invoice, bank statement, and ledger; the invoice's own tax breakdown (36000) is simply not restated on the other documents, which is expected since those documents record total values rather than tax splits. The receipt lacks a monetary amount/currency field - this is noted as a goods-receipt limitation, not treated as inconsistency, and its presence (not the successful bank payment) is what establishes that any receipt-based payment term was satisfied. Date sequence (order -> invoice -> receipt -> payment/ledger) is logical. No document type expected for a standard PO-based procurement-to-pay cycle appears to be missing.
